name: Xciel XCZ1 iPhone 14
statusNote: Xciel still publishes a datasheet, but we found no current reseller listing. Check availability with Xciel.
summary: The Xciel XCZ1 iPhone 14 is a flameproof (Ex db) case for the Apple iPhone 14, certified for Zone 1 under ATEX and IECEx. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 14 running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIB T5 Gb

safety.conditions: Flameproof Ex db enclosure. iPhone must not be removed from the aluminium case; no charging (cable or wireless) when a hazardous atmosphere is present; use a suitably approved charger; flameproof joints not modified or repaired; fasteners thread-locked (only the charging-port cover fasteners are user-replaceable); rubber corner bumpers must be fitted and inspected before each use (IECEx EXV 22.0024X).

os.name: iOS
os.updates: Security updates for 7+ years (based on previous model support)

specs.display: 6.1-inch OLED Super Retina XDR; Ceramic Shield
specs.batteryLife: Up to 20 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)
specs.keys: Side, volume, Ring/Silent switch (no Action Button)
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (QR via Camera) / Via app (1D/2D)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (Core NFC); not verified through metal enclosure

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Built in on iPhone; not verified through enclosure

unconfirmed.certification.atex.marking: From Xciel's datasheet. The IECEx certificate confirms Ex db IIB Gb but gives the temperature class only in its description, and no ATEX certificate number is published.
unconfirmed.certification.iecex.marking: From Xciel's datasheet. The IECEx certificate confirms Ex db IIB Gb but gives the temperature class only in its description, and no ATEX certificate number is published.
unconfirmed.certification.ambient: From the IECEx certificate. Xciel's datasheet says −20 °C to +45 °C.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.

strengths: A standard Apple iPhone 14 inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: May be near the end of its life: check availability before ordering
Gas group IIB: not rated for hydrogen or acetylene
Temperature class not confirmed by a certificate we've seen
